messages.snippet: Team, The one issue that matters here is clause 11. Calderbrook will open at a £6m cap (= upfront).
messages.subject: Lyra — negotiation strategy on the liability cap
messages.plaintextBody:
Team,

The one issue that matters here is clause 11. Calderbrook will open at a £6m cap (= upfront). That's far too low for a licensee paying out potentially £155m of biodollars. Our landing zone: (a) IP warranties (9.2-9.6) and confidentiality fully uncapped; (b) general cap at the greater of £10m or 12 months' payments. Elena, please prepare a short note for Helena explaining why the £6m cap is unacceptable given the milestone exposure. James, hold the line on the audit threshold at 5%.

Sarah

--

messages.snippet: Will have the note to you by tomorrow. I'll frame it around the asymmetry: a £6m cap means a warrant
messages.subject: RE: Lyra — negotiation strategy on the liability cap
messages.plaintextBody:
Will have the note to you by tomorrow. I'll frame it around the asymmetry: a £6m cap means a warranty failure on chain of title could leave us with a worthless licence but only £6m of recourse, against £6m already paid on day one. The greater-of-£10m / 12-months formulation is the market norm for deals of this size.

Elena
